name: Adminer
summary: Browse and edit a database from the browser, like phpMyAdmin in a hosting panel.
description: The Apache-2.0 / GPL-2.0 Adminer database manager by Jakub Vrana, packaged from its pinned upstream container image (5.5.1). It opens behind Automaton sign-in, then asks for a database host, user and password, so no credentials are stored in the package. Private only. It reaches databases its own container can reach.
